SELECT p.*, c.name as category_name, u.username as seller_name FROM t_product p LEFT JOIN t_category c ON p.category_id = c.id LEFT JOIN t_user u ON p.seller_id = u.id WHERE p.status = 1
AND p.category_id = #{categoryId}
AND p.title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%')
ORDER BY p.create_time DESC

SELECT p.*, c.name as category_name, u.username as seller_name FROM t_product p LEFT JOIN t_category c ON p.category_id = c.id LEFT JOIN t_user u ON p.seller_id = u.id WHERE 1=1
AND p.category_id = #{categoryId}
AND p.title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%')
ORDER BY p.create_time DESC

SELECT p.*, c.name as category_name, u.username as seller_name, u.phone as seller_phone FROM t_product p LEFT JOIN t_category c ON p.category_id = c.id LEFT JOIN t_user u ON p.seller_id = u.id WHERE p.id = #{id}
SELECT p.*, c.name as category_name FROM t_product p LEFT JOIN t_category c ON p.category_id = c.id WHERE p.seller_id = #{sellerId} ORDER BY p.create_time DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_product (title, description, price, original_price, category_id, seller_id, images, status, view_count) VALUES (#{title}, #{description}, #{price}, #{originalPrice}, #{categoryId}, #{sellerId}, #{images}, #{status}, #{viewCount})
mapper.update: UPDATE t_product SET status = #{status} WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE t_product SET view_count = view_count + 1 WHERE id = #{id}
